clue.text: Sadat kept it back being pacific

indicators.note: kept means held inside, so the first name encloses the other piece

parts.note: Anwar Sadat was the Egyptian president, so his first name stands in for him

indicators.note: back means the little word it is read in the reverse direction

explanation.surface: A remark that the Egyptian leader held something in reserve while acting peaceably.
explanation.walkthrough: Sadat looks like a whole person but supplies only his first name; 'back' makes TI, and 'kept' signals the enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacific means peace-loving, and someone opposed to fighting is pacifist in outlook.

clue.text: Austria and Germany feud? That's aimless!

parts.note: A is the international vehicle code for Austria
D is the international vehicle code for Germany (Deutschland)
a rift is a quarrel or feud

explanation.surface: A quarrel between two neighbouring countries leaves things without purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Drifting without direction or purpose is being without aim.

parts.note: ta is British informal for thanks
a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: Grateful to a poet for a coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a sleeveless tunic or jacket, worn by heralds.

clue.text: Booze runs out of case from bottle

indicators.note: out of means the drink word lies outside the case word

parts.note: wine is alcohol, booze
a chest is a case or box
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Drink pours from a crate of bottles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' signals one piece outside another. A Winchester is a large bottle for chemicals, so 'bottle' is a noun, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A Winchester is a large cylindrical bottle, used chiefly for chemicals and liquids.

clue.text: Insurgent endlessly clubs old sound producer

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the insurgent word is dropped

parts.note: a rebel is an insurgent
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A rebel keeps hitting an ancient noisemaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the tail to leave REBE; the instrument was a bowed medieval forerunner of the fiddle.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebec is a medieval stringed instrument played with a bow, an early music maker.

clue.text: Winged beast rejected drink containing herb

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the whole assembly is read in the reverse direction
containing means the drink word holds the herb inside it

parts.note: to sup is to drink
sage is a culinary herb

explanation.surface: A creature with wings turned down a beverage with herbs in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containing' signals the herb going inside, then 'rejected' turns the whole assembly to give SUSAGEP read right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the flying horse is the most famous winged beast of all.

indicators.note: hides means the cleaner word conceals the meat word inside it

parts.note: purer means cleaner, less contaminated
loin is a cut of meat

explanation.surface: A cleaner conceals meat from a robber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cleaner' reads as a person, but it is the comparative adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: To purloin is to steal, so one who purloins is a thief.

clue.text: Foreman, without hesitation, produces landing gear

indicators.note: without means the hesitation is taken away

parts.note: gaffer is British slang for a foreman or boss
er is a hesitation sound

explanation.surface: A works boss speaks decisively about undercarriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'landing gear' suggests an aircraft, but means equipment for landing a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaff is a hooked pole used by anglers to land large fish.

indicators.note: to puzzle the letters is to jumble them up confusingly

explanation.surface: An Oscar winner set a riddle for a great thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'puzzle' rearranges the letters of OSCAR SET.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian thinker is the archetypal Greek philosopher.

indicators.note: to restrict means the petition word confines the Vikings within it

parts.note: to sue is to petition or appeal
the Danes were Viking raiders

explanation.surface: An African petitions to limit Norse invaders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to restrict' signals that the Norse raiders are confined within the petition word.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from Sudan, a north-east African nation, is a national of that country.

clue.text: Winger not fully putting on clothes

indicators.note: not fully means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: robing is dressing, putting on clothes or robes

explanation.surface: A wing player is only half-dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not fully' drops the last letter G from ROBING. 'Winger' looks like a sports player but is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A winger is anything with wings, here the familiar red-breasted garden bird.

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so the other pieces go inside the weak word

parts.note: bad can mean poor or weak, as in a bad effort
a referee, or ref, is a sports adjudicator
ace means excellent or superb

explanation.surface: A judge's fine verdict cracks a feeble patent claim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' signals insertion. 'patent' looks like the noun for an invention but is the adjective meaning obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent as an adjective means blatant or obvious, as is a shameless, barefaced lie.

clue.text: About to get fired? Away and ring the president!

parts.note: forth means away or onward, as in going forth
to echo is to ring or resound
P is the abbreviation for president

explanation.surface: A worried employee told to leave goes off to phone the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase means facing dismissal or destruction, so the question mark flags the idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: someone in line for the axe is likely to be sacked soon.

indicators.note: put in means the letter is placed inside the jail word

parts.note: the can is slang for prison or jail

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to locking up a killer.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the first son of Adam killed his brother Abel, making him the first murderer.

parts.note: bent is slang for corrupt or dishonest
a double is a lookalike who impersonates someone

explanation.surface: A crooked lookalike is stooping.
explanation.definitionFit: Being folded forward at the waist describes someone stooped or hunched over.

clue.text: Worry about endless fury with navy irregularity

indicators.note: about means the worry word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: stress is worry or strain

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the fury word is removed

parts.note: anger is fury

explanation.surface: Concern about boundless rage and the navy looks odd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims the fury word to ANGE, and 'about' signals the worry word wrapping round it and the navy letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Oddness or peculiarity is strangeness, so an irregularity is a synonym.

clue.text: A cur hit me unexpectedly and I'm in pain

definitions.note: the definition is phrased as a sufferer speaking of themselves

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests things turning out otherwise, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A dog bit me out of the blue and now I ache.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' rearranges the letters of A CUR HIT ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone afflicted with rheumatism is a sufferer whose joints ache painfully.

definitions.meaning: a shop carrying goods is keeping them in supply
a hosiery item for the leg and foot

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb form of keeping in supply and a leg garment.

parts.note: an artisan is a skilled craftsman

explanation.surface: A coin is taken by a craftsman beneath the street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'underground' looks like a place but means a resistance fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: A partisan is a member of an armed resistance movement, the underground.

clue.text: Street cred — a fusion of special expertise

indicators.note: a fusion melts things together into a new form, so these letters are remixed

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Being cool on the street mixed with something else gives a particular skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fusion of' rearranges the letters of STREET CRED plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: A closely guarded technique known only within a business is special know-how kept private.

clue.text: Spies accept a set of rules in Africa

indicators.note: accept means the spies take the other pieces inside

parts.note: MI, Military Intelligence, stands for spies
a law is a rule or code of rules

explanation.surface: Agents agree to a legal code somewhere in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accept' signals that the intelligence abbreviation takes the rest inside it; MI stands for British Military Intelligence.
explanation.definitionFit: Malawi is a landlocked country located in south-east Africa.

indicators.note: ordered means put in a fresh arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A prescribed dose for a sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges the letters of DOSAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: An old sea dog is a seasoned sailor or mariner.

parts.note: the cat, short for cat-o'-nine-tails, is a whip

explanation.surface: Lashing an ancient Roman politician.
explanation.definitionFit: The elder of that name was a famous Roman statesman and censor.

clue.text: In the morning old priest's lecture is to make things better

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning
Eli was the Old Testament priest who taught Samuel
to orate is to give a lecture or speech

explanation.surface: An early sermon by an aged cleric aims to improve matters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eli' is the biblical priest of Shiloh, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: To ameliorate is to improve a situation, making it better.

clue.text: Large old ship is broad and slow

parts.note: the Argo was Jason's ship in Greek legend

explanation.surface: A big ancient vessel is wide and sluggish.
explanation.definitionFit: Largo is a musical direction meaning slow and broad in tempo.

parts.note: a sovereign was a pound coin, abbreviated L
an ear is an appreciation, as in an ear for music

explanation.surface: A monarch enjoys a comic writer.
explanation.walkthrough: A sovereign is an old British gold pound coin; 'Sovereign' suggests the king of the play.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Lear was the Victorian humorist famous for nonsense verse and limericks.

indicators.note: something done cunningly is crafty and twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An official evaluator sneaked in with great stealth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cunningly' rearranges the letters of CREPT IN SO.
explanation.definitionFit: An inspector assesses premises or work, so the two words are near synonyms.

parts.note: the rand is the currency of South Africa

explanation.surface: Note the British and overseas currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A brand is a mark burnt or stamped to show ownership.

indicators.note: after means the boy's name comes later than the information

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
Eric is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad following the news that covers everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Generic describes something general covering a whole class, so broadly comprehensive.

definitions.meaning: an ... move or night is the first one
a chance or gap to take

explanation.definitionFit: Opening serves as an adjective meaning initial and a noun meaning a chance.
